wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: The seven live Form A rows sum to 1,135.00, which equals the schedule's own final TOTAL (three earlier figures in the TOTAL cell are struck out and 1,135.00 is written fresh below the cell). 1,135.00 is NOT cover line 1 in either column, and that is explained on the page: this filer ITEMIZED his sub-$50 gifts on Form A as well. 1,135.00 - 1,050.00 = 85.00, exactly the cover's line-2 ($50.00-or-less aggregate) THIS REPORT cell, so Form A here carries line1-THIS + line2-THIS. Scoring the rows against cover line 1 alone would report a false 85.00 shortfall, and scoring against filing_totals.stated_total_contributions (line1+line2) would be right only for the PERIOD, not the cumulative figure this module publishes. SCOPE IS PERIOD, NOT CUMULATIVE: the cycle-to-date cells are 2,250.00 / 110.00 (= 2,360.00) and no row set on this sheet reaches them -- the schedule restates only June 14 - October 26, 2018. Per the addendum this is a different scope from what the module publishes, so reconciles_* is expected to stay blank; it is not a failure. Note the filer treated one of his two $50.00 gifts as over-$50 and the other as $50-or-less (the statute's line 1 is 'more than $50.00'); that inconsistency is the FILER's and is retained verbatim.
contributions.competing_anchor_note: cover line1 THIS 1050.00 and line1 CUM 2250.00 both fail; schedule TOTAL 1135.00 closes exactly

expenditures.basis: schedule-total (== cover line3 THIS == cover line3 CUMULATIVE)
expenditures.detail: 39 Form B rows sum to 4,066.29, matching the printed schedule TOTAL and cover line 3 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns. The TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT cell for expenses is a slashed zero glyph (= 0 per the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling, verbatim glyph kept), so no expenditure was reported earlier in the cycle and the two scopes coincide -- recorded as cumulative, the coincidence stated here. Four rows are dated before the certified period start (5/31, 5/31, 6/13, 6/13) which is consistent with this sheet carrying the whole cycle's spending.

Cover line-1 anchors do NOT gate against Form A and the cause is traced above (sub-$50 gifts itemized on Form A).
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p2 and p3 both report geometry_status 'gaps'/'ok' with 33 bands over a ~41-row grid -- the tool drops rules here (standing DEBT), so bands were mapped by hand from the detected pitch (1.827% of page height, header rule at ~11.7%). p2: 8 inked grid rows, 7 emitted (grid row 7 is struck out by the filer, see notes) -- every grid row 9+ renders empty. p3: 40 grid rows, 39 inked, 39 emitted, grid row 40 renders an empty '$' cell.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: 600-dpi crop of line 1's amount box renders '$ 100'; the crop of line 7's box (grid row 8) renders '$ 50'; the control crop one row-pitch below renders an EMPTY '$' cell. p3: line 1's box renders '$ 360.'; line 39's box renders '$ 150.00'; the control one pitch below renders an EMPTY '$' cell.
gates.balance_chain: DOES NOT CLOSE, and the residual is the FILER's arithmetic, retained verbatim. Cumulative contributions 2,250.00 + 110.00 = 2,360.00 less cumulative expenses 4,066.29 = -1,706.29, but the printed line-4 balance (CUMULATIVE column only; the LAST and THIS cells are blank) reads 4,060.29 -- which is neither the computed balance nor a copy of the expense figure 4,066.29 (it differs from it by 6.00). Both figures are reported as printed and nothing was recomputed. The cover's own two horizontal chains DO close: 1,200.00 + 1,050.00 = 2,250.00 (line 1) and 25.00 + 85.00 = 110.00 (line 2, written over a struck-out 60.00). No earlier filing by this filer is in my chunk, so the cover-to-cover CUMULATIVE -> TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT chain could not be run; a human with the June 2018 filing should run it, since line-1 LAST = 1,200.00 is the only external check on this cover.

notes: Generation-2 county-branded form ('Campaign Financial Disclosure Per Title 1 Chapter 7 of Washington County Code of Ordinances', header 'WASHINGTON COUNTY CANDIDATE FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT', law cited as Washington County Code 1-7-1). CHUNK FILE AGREES WITH THE DOCUMENT: candidate 'Robert E. Ford' matches the cover's 'Full Name of Candidate: Robert E. Ford', and office 'Commission Seat A' matches the cover's Office line, which reads verbatim 'Running for: Seat A, County Commission'. County office, in scope. Certified period 'beginning June 14, 2018 and ending October 26, 2018'; the signature Date line reads 'June 26, 2018' -- INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT with a period ending October 26 and with the file name's 10-30-2018, and it is retained verbatim rather than corrected. STRUCK-OUT LEDGER LINE: p2 grid row 7 (date 'July 7', an illegible name struck through end to end, the address cell struck through, amount '$3?' struck through) is VOIDED BY THE FILER and is NOT emitted as a row. The ARITHMETIC is the proof, not the appearance: the seven remaining rows sum to 1,135.00, the filer's own final TOTAL; adding the struck line (~30) reaches 1,165.00, which matches no printed figure on the document. NO YEAR IS PRINTED IN ANY DATE CELL except Form A line 1 ('6/14/18'), so 6 of 7 contribution rows and all 39 expenditure rows carry a BLANK date with needs_review=1 and the verbatim day/month in the note -- this is a uniform FORM-FILLING property of the document, not a legibility problem, and no year was carried in from the report date. Every amount is legible; no row is blank for illegibility and neither side is a floor. Candidate street address, PO box, ZIP and home phone printed in the clear on the cover were discarded at read time, as were all donor street addresses, PO boxes and ZIPs.
